raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Auxiliary hidden-state capture is the per-layer concatenation that EAGLE3, DFLASH and DSPARK drafts consume. Today it is only reachable by loading a speculative draft; `ModelRunner` carries a `TODO: expose this to server args?` for it.

Data-generation and draft-training pipelines need these hidden states from a plain target server. Without this change they either patch SGLang or re-run the target in a separate process.

## Modifications

- **New server arguments** (`exec.features`, both off by default):
  - `--aux-hidden-state-capture {eagle3,dflash,dspark}` wires the target model's existing capture hook without a draft: `set_eagle3_layers_to_capture`, `set_dflash_layers_to_capture`, or the native `set_dspark_layers_to_capture` when the model has one.
  - `--aux-hidden-state-layer-ids` selects the layers, using the same convention as a draft config's target layer ids. It is required for dflash and dspark; eagle3 falls back to the model's default EAGLE3 layers.
- **Resolver.** `resolve_spec_aux_hidden_state_config` handles the capture-only case. It resolves no draft layer counts, so the KV pool reserves nothing for a draft.
- **DSPARK hook routing.** It moves from `spec_algorithm.is_dspark()` to the resolved config (`SpecAuxHiddenStateConfig.is_dspark`), so capture-only DSPARK picks the native hook. Behavior is unchanged for speculative runs.
- **Hidden-state capture output.** Capture then returns the aux concatenation through the existing paths (`return_hidden_states`, `--return-hidden-states-mode`). Aux capture replaces `hidden_states`, so under full capture the post-norm last-layer hidden states are kept next to it in a new `LogitsProcessorOutput.last_hidden_states`. The decode and prefill CUDA-graph runners trim it like `hidden_states`.
- **Validation.** `validate_aux_hidden_state_capture` rejects layer ids without a method, dflash/dspark without layer ids, and either option combined with `--speculative-algorithm`.
- **Docs.** Rows added to `server_arguments.mdx`.

Example (no draft loaded):

```bash
python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path Qwen/Qwen3-8B \
  --aux-hidden-state-capture dflash --aux-hidden-state-layer-ids 1 9 17 25 33 \
  --return-hidden-states-mode full
```

A request with `"return_hidden_states": true` then receives the concatenated hidden states of the five layers.

## Accuracy Tests

One GB300 (CUDA 13), image `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20261006-f3fe7534` with SGLang main `8c273d6813` + #43448, this PR and #43450 (maocheng23/sglang `spec-capture/integration`) overlaid. The SpecForge capture plugin (sgl-project/SpecForge#945) is the consumer.

- **Against an independent forward.** Tiny Llama target (8 layers, hidden 64), `--aux-hidden-state-capture eagle3 --aux-hidden-state-layer-ids 1 3 4 --return-hidden-states-mode full`:
  - across the three gate tests (EAGLE3 and DFlash feature layouts), the aux states match a separate HF forward of the same layers within bf16 tolerance (2e-2);
  - `lm_head(last_hidden_states)` reproduces HF's logits within that tolerance;
  - one EAGLE3 training step on the captured features gives a finite loss.
- **Real model.** Qwen3.8-27B (hybrid GDN, 64 layers), TP1, `--aux-hidden-state-capture dflash --aux-hidden-state-layer-ids 5 19 33 47 61 --return-hidden-states-mode full`:
  - shapes are `[L, 25600]` (aux) and `[L, 5120]` (last hidden) for L = 7 to 4096;
  - the captured aux rows equal what this PR returns through `return_hidden_states` (max abs diff 0.0);
  - `lm_head` of the last kept hidden state picks the token the server samples greedily.
- On the GPU image, this PR's tests pass together with the #43448 and #43450 suites and `test_auxiliary_output.py` (75 passed).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

With both options off, the only change on the serving path is one attribute check per eager logits-processor call. CUDA-graph replays don't execute that Python. Nothing changes in kernels, memory or IPC.

Measured together with #43450 (see the `bench_serving` A/B there): parity with main on Qwen3.8-27B for both decode and prefill.

## Tests

`test/registered/unit/model_executor/model_runner_components/test_aux_hidden_state_capture.py` (CPU, 19 cases):
- CLI parsing and every validation rule;
- the resolved config for eagle3/dflash/dspark, including that no draft KV is reserved and draft runners never capture;
- DSPARK→DFLASH hook routing;
- a real `LogitsProcessor.forward`: full capture with the flag returns aux in `hidden_states` and the input states in `last_hidden_states`; without the flag (stock EAGLE3/DFLASH serving) and under LAST/NULL capture, `last_hidden_states` stays `None`.

Server-args registry, namespace and CLI-metadata suites pass unchanged.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+"""Unit tests for --aux-hidden-state-capture (aux capture without a draft)."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest

+

+)

+    resolve_spec_aux_hidden_state_config,
+)
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs, prepare_server_args
+from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_info import SpeculativeAlgorithm
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import published_topology
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=8, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+VOCAB, HIDDEN, NUM_AUX = 11, 4, 3
+
+
+def _resolve(*, is_draft_worker=False):
+    return resolve_spec_aux_hidden_state_config(
+        server_args=None,
+        model_config=None,
+        spec_algorithm=SpeculativeAlgorithm.from_string(None),
+        is_draft_worker=is_draft_worker,
+    )
+
+
+# --- server arguments --------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_cli_parses_method_and_layer_ids():
+    args = prepare_server_args(
+        [
+            "--model-path",
+            "dummy",
+            "--aux-hidden-state-capture",
+            "dflash",
+            "--aux-hidden-state-layer-ids",
+            "1",
+            "16",
+            "31",
+        ]
+    )
+    args.resolve_once()
+    assert args.aux_hidden_state_capture == "dflash"
+    assert args.aux_hidden_state_layer_ids == [1, 16, 31]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "fields,match",
+    [
+        (
+            dict(aux_hidden_state_layer_ids=[1, 2]),
+            "requires --aux-hidden-state-capture",
+        ),
+        (
+            dict(aux_hidden_state_capture="dflash"),
+            "requires --aux-hidden-state-layer-ids",
+        ),
+        (
+            dict(aux_hidden_state_capture="dspark"),
+            "requires --aux-hidden-state-layer-ids",
+        ),
+        (
+            dict(aux_hidden_state_capture="eagle3", speculative_algorithm="EAGLE3"),
+            "cannot be combined with --speculative-algorithm",
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+def test_invalid_combinations_are_rejected(fields, match):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=match):
+        ServerArgs(model_path="dummy", **fields).resolve_once()
+
+
+def test_eagle3_defaults_to_model_layers():
+    ServerArgs(model_path="dummy", aux_hidden_state_capture="eagle3").resolve_once()
+
+
+# --- aux capture config ------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_disabled_by_default():
+    with published_topology():
+        config = _resolve()
+    assert not config.eagle_use_aux_hidden_state
+    assert not config.dflash_use_aux_hidden_state
+    assert not config.is_dspark
+
+
+def test_eagle3_capture_without_draft():
+    with published_topology(
+        aux_hidden_state_capture="eagle3", aux_hidden_state_layer_ids=[1, 5]

+class _Model:
+    def __init__(self, *hooks):
+        self.calls = []
+        for hook in hooks:
+            setattr(self, hook, lambda ids, _hook=hook: self.calls.append((_hook, ids)))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "is_dspark,hooks,expected",
+    [
+        (
+            True,
+            ("set_dspark_layers_to_capture", "set_dflash_layers_to_capture"),
+            "set_dspark_layers_to_capture",
+        ),
+        (
+            False,
+            ("set_dspark_layers_to_capture", "set_dflash_layers_to_capture"),
+            "set_dflash_layers_to_capture",
+        ),
+        # Without a native DSPARK hook, DSPARK rides the DFLASH capture.
+        (True, ("set_dflash_layers_to_capture",), "set_dflash_layers_to_capture"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_dflash_family_hook_routing(is_dspark, hooks, expected):
+    model = _Model(*hooks)
+    configure_aux_hidden_state_capture(
+        model=model,
+        eagle_use_aux_hidden_state=False,
+        eagle_aux_hidden_state_layer_ids=None,
+        dflash_use_aux_hidden_state=True,
+        dflash_target_layer_ids=[2, 3],
+        is_dspark=is_dspark,
+    )
+    assert model.calls == [(expected, [2, 3])]
+

+# --- logits processor --------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _logits_metadata(capture_hidden_mode, extend_seq_lens):
+    return LogitsMetadata(
+        forward_mode=ForwardMode.EXTEND,
+        capture_hidden_mode=capture_hidden_mode,
+        extend_seq_lens=torch.tensor(extend_seq_lens),
+        extend_seq_lens_cpu=list(extend_seq_lens),
+    )
+
+
+def _run_logits_processor(capture_hidden_mode, *, with_aux=True, **server_fields):
+    extend_seq_lens = [3, 2]
+    num_tokens = sum(extend_seq_lens)
+    hidden_states = torch.randn(num_tokens, HIDDEN)
+    aux = [torch.randn(num_tokens, HIDDEN) for _ in range(NUM_AUX)]
+    lm_head_weight = torch.randn(VOCAB, HIDDEN)
+    with published_topology(**server_fields):
+        processor = LogitsProcessor(SimpleNamespace(vocab_size=VOCAB))
+        with patch.object(
+            processor,
+            "_get_logits",
+            side_effect=lambda states, *args, **kwargs: states @ lm_head_weight.T,
+        ):
+            output = processor(
+                torch.zeros(num_tokens, dtype=torch.long),
+                hidden_states,
+                None,
+                _logits_metadata(capture_hidden_mode, extend_seq_lens),
+                aux_hidden_states=aux if with_aux else None,
+            )
+    return output, hidden_states, aux
+
+
+def test_full_capture_keeps_last_hidden_next_to_aux():
+    output, hidden_states, aux = _run_logits_processor(
+        CaptureHiddenMode.FULL,
+        aux_hidden_state_capture="dflash",
+        aux_hidden_state_layer_ids=[0, 1, 2],
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(output.hidden_states, torch.cat(aux, dim=-1))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(output.last_hidden_states, hidden_states)
+
+
+def test_last_hidden_is_not_kept_without_the_flag():
+    # Stock EAGLE3/DFLASH serving also captures FULL + aux; it must not change.
+    output, _, aux = _run_logits_processor(CaptureHiddenMode.FULL)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(output.hidden_states, torch.cat(aux, dim=-1))
+    assert output.last_hidden_states is None
+

+)

+        with_aux=with_aux,
+        aux_hidden_state_capture="eagle3",
